definitions.explanation: The state of having eaten enough and feeling full. A more formal word compared to the casual お{腹|なか}いっぱい.

examples.japanese: ご{飯|はん}をたくさん{食|た}べて{満腹|まんぷく}だ。
examples.english: I ate a lot and I'm full.

examples.japanese: {満腹|まんぷく}になるまで{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I ate until I was completely full.

examples.japanese: {満腹|まんぷく}{中枢|ちゅうすう}が{刺激|しげき}される。

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
・{満|まん} (full) + {腹|ぷく} (stomach/belly)

RELATED TERMS:
・{空腹|くうふく} (empty stomach/hunger) - antonym
・お{腹|なか}いっぱい (I'm full - casual)
・{腹八分|はらはちぶ} (eating until 80% full - health principle)
・{食|た}べ{過|す}ぎ (overeating)

EXPRESSIONS:
・{満腹|まんぷく}{感|かん} (feeling of fullness)
・{満腹|まんぷく}になる (to become full)
・{腹八分目|はらはちぶんめ}に{医者|いしゃ}いらず (Eating in moderation keeps the doctor away - proverb)

SCIENTIFIC CONTEXT:
・{満腹|まんぷく}{中枢|ちゅうすう} (satiety center - in the brain)
・{満腹|まんぷく}ホルモン (satiety hormones like leptin)

DINING CULTURE:
・Saying ごちそうさまでした indicates satisfaction with the meal
・Japanese portion sizes often aim for {腹八分|はらはちぶ} (80% full)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{満腹|まんぷく}になる (to become full)
・{満腹|まんぷく}{感|かん}を{得|え}る (to feel satisfied/full)
・{満腹|まんぷく}で{動|うご}けない (so full I can't move)
